description: Fix remaining Phase 3 audit issues across all modules: EAPOL identification enhancement, error handling, platform checks, import fixes, attack timing, and thread consistency
steps: 1. posframework/recon.py - Enhance _identify_eapol_message() to handle FT reassociation (key_info bit 12 = FT flag) and group key handshakes (2-way: key_ack with secure bit set but no install). Add key_data_length check for better disambiguation. This fixes Issues #7 and #22.

2. posframework/beacons.py - Wrap add_probed_ssids_from_db() in try/except to handle: missing probed_ssids column, None values in row[0], empty database. Log warning on failure but do not crash. This fixes Issue #9.

3. posframework/karma.py - Add try/except around the sendp() call in _beacon_loop(). Log errors but continue the loop. Also add an outer try/except for the entire loop body to prevent thread death. This fixes Issue #10.

4. posframework/mitm.py - Add a platform check at the top of start() method. If IS_WINDOWS, log a warning that MITM via ARP poisoning has limited support on Windows with Npcap. Allow the attack to proceed but warn the user. Import IS_WINDOWS from config. This partially fixes Issue #15.

5. posframework/dns_spoof.py - Add a platform check in start(). If IS_WINDOWS, log warning about limited raw socket DNS spoofing on Windows. Import IS_WINDOWS from config. This partially fixes Issue #15.
6. posframework/ssl_strip.py - Add a platform check in start(). If IS_WINDOWS, log warning about limited SSL stripping on Windows. Import IS_WINDOWS from config. This partially fixes Issue #15.

7. posframework/__main__.py - In verify_interface(), when IS_WINDOWS and check_npcap_monitor_support() returns True, actually instantiate WindowsMonitorManager and call enable_monitor_mode(). Store the manager reference for later teardown. This fixes Issue #19.

8. posframework/orchestrator.py - Fix imports: (a) Remove unused 'wrpcap' from scapy.all import. (b) Add 'Dot11ProbeReq, Dot11Elt' to the scapy.layers.dot11 import (they are used in _background_recon but not imported). This fixes Issue #25 and a hidden bug.

9. posframework/orchestrator.py - Add attack start/end time logging. In start(), record self._start_time = time.time() and log it. In stop(), compute duration and log 'Attack duration: X.X seconds'. This fixes Issue #26.

10. posframework/deauth.py - Add an optional verification callback. Add a 'verify_callback' parameter to __init__. If set, after each deauth burst, call verify_callback(bssid, client_mac) to check if client disconnected. This fixes Issue #23.
11. posframework/deauth.py - The join(timeout=5) is already in place. Confirm thread daemon flag consistency - the thread is already daemon=True. No change needed for Issue #24 here.
12. posframework/karma.py - Ensure _thread.join(timeout=5) is already present (it is). No change needed for Issue #24.
13. posframework/beacons.py - Ensure _thread.join(timeout=5) is already present (it is). No change needed for Issue #24.
